target: Falsify raw causal-use indispensability as an arbitrary-algorithm EXTRACTOR/G2 premise.
quantifiers: For every total uniform deterministic decider A and every polynomial-time-computable intervention budget s(N), there exists an extensionally equal uniform deterministic decider A_hat_s robust to every raw checkpoint overwrite of at most s(N) cells.
model: Uniform deterministic checkpoint transition machine with fixed read-only input and explicit finite work configuration.
same_realization: charged compiled time and work state

claim.retired: Polynomially bounded raw-coordinate causal indispensability is universal.
open: all-input source-first strict successor with lambda < 1

barriers.relativization: The countercompiler relativizes and therefore does not supply a separating hinge.
barriers.algebrization: Algebraic-oracle access does not restore raw-coordinate indispensability; no nonalgebrizing hinge is supplied.
barriers.natural_proofs: Not triggered because no constructive large circuit property is asserted.
